'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Arvind Bhasker DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Arvind Bhasker]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Arvind
* '''Deck name:''' Bad Deck 2
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
